info.text:
Best quarter in its history. Then Friday, the stock slid about 6%.
Applied Materials, which makes chipmaking machines, reported record revenue of $10.41 billion, up 53% (Nov 12, 2026).
Full-year revenue: a record $34.45 billion, up 21%.
Analysts expected about $10.30 billion. Shares fell about 6% in Friday morning trading as chip-equipment stocks slid and analysts trimmed price targets.
Sources: Applied Materials Q4 FY2026 release; Investing.com; 24/7 Wall St.
News and education, not financial advice.
